items.title: Missions to clear
items.text: 39 one-off missions across every game, in ☰ Missions: a full day of dailies, a song from its 1-second clip, a halo from its silhouette, a multiplayer win and more. Rounds you've already played count, and a mission stays cleared even after a reset.

items.title: Things to unlock
items.text: Some missions unlock a title and new colours for your Sensei card, and new colours for the cursor's flash and trail, picked on the card and in Settings.

items.title: Your profile
items.text: ☰ Profile shows your card and your whole record: every game's wins, streaks, average tries, daily puzzles by tries, Time Attack bests and fastest finds. Customize it with a title on a banner, a frame and a background scene, unlocked by missions.

items.title: New students beside the game
items.text: Shiroko, Hoshino, Hina and Aris can now stand beside the game on wide screens, each unlocked by a mission. Pick one in Settings.

items.title: More ways to set up a room
items.text: A room's host can now pick which OST albums the songs come from, as many as they like, and have Voice play title calls only. Skip is back, for a round nobody knows.

items.title: A new look for rooms
items.text: Rooms have a new lobby: the code on a ticket with the settings under it, and everyone on a card with their student, in the lobby, the rounds and on the podium. Everyone's card wears the title, banner, frame and background they picked in Customize, so friends see what you've unlocked. Before a room, your card sits over two big cards: Join a room, with Paste for a friend's code or link, and Make a room. On a phone the settings fold away, so the players fit on screen.

items.title: Your name and picture in your profile
items.text: Set your name and favourite student in Customize: they're on your card, your shared pictures and the Sensei card, and rooms use them too (pick another student for a room if you like). The OST badges and the Sensei card have moved into your profile, which now keeps its size as you switch tabs.

items.title: The Jukebox's own volume
items.text: The Jukebox now has a volume of its own, so music to listen to and clips to name can sit at different levels.

items.title: Kivotos through the year
items.text: The background now dresses up for the time of year, not only Christmas and New Year: Valentine's, cherry blossom, the beach, a summer festival, Halloween, autumn leaves, and both servers' anniversaries. A streak place still wins from 10 wins in a row. Multiplayer has a room of its own, too.

items.title: Play with friends
items.text: Make a private room and share its code: up to 8 players play the OST, Voice or Picture game together, everyone hearing the same song at once, as in Anime Music Quiz. Send an answer (Quick answer sends your first pick at once) and change your mind as often as you like until the time's up; everyone sees when each player's latest answer went. The fastest right answers break a tie. The host picks the game, answers, rounds, time and the room's server, can save them as presets to share with friends, can give the room a password or lock it, and can kick a player; ending a game early needs most of the room to agree.

items.title: Anna and Erina
items.text: On the JP server, Anna and Erina now have voice lines in Voice and halos in Picture. Their lines' text is Japanese until the English version is out.

name: Halos, weapons and a home page

items.title: A home page
items.text: baheardle.com now opens on every game at once, with how today's daily puzzles went, a button to carry on where you left off, your record, what's on in Global (or JP) right now: pickups, event and raids and this week's birthdays. Each game has its own page to bookmark or share (baheardle.com/voice, say); the bar under the header moves between them, and the logo brings you home.

items.title: JP server
items.text: Students, Voice and Picture can follow the JP server, with the students Global doesn't have yet. Pick Global or JP on the home page or in Settings; each keeps its own daily puzzles, rounds and stats.

items.title: Jukebox on every page
items.text: The Jukebox now plays on after you close it in every game, until a clip or a voice line starts. Resetting a mode's stats has moved from About to Settings, where it names the game and mode it clears.

items.title: Picture
items.text: A new game, beside Voice: see a halo or a weapon and name its student. Halo or Weapon sits above the game. Costumes share a halo and most share a gun, so naming any student it belongs to is right.

items.title: Every way to play
items.text: A daily halo and a daily weapon, each with its own streak and calendar, and in Endless: Classic, with four tries and a hint after each miss (school, club, then their silhouette) or no hints; 4-Choice; and Time Attack. Turn Silhouette on in any of them to see only the picture's shape. Share pictures and recaps too.

items.title: Voice
items.text: A third game beside the OST and Students: hear a student's line, their title call or one from the lobby, and name them. You get four tries, and each miss shows a hint: their school, then their club, then their silhouette. Every costume is its own answer.

items.title: Every way to play
items.text: Voice has a daily puzzle with its own streak and calendar, and in Endless: Classic (hints on or off, each with its own stats), 4-Choice (four voices that sound alike) and Time Attack, with every line or title calls only. The result plays the line again and shows what the student said, in English. Share a picture of your round or run, or a recap from Stats.

items.title: Pick, then guess
items.text: In Voice and Students, picking a name from the list or the grid puts it in the search box; press Enter or Guess to send it, as in the OST. Students has a Random first guess to get you started, and its clock now starts with your first guess, not your first letter.

items.title: Solve time
items.text: In Students, a clock starts when you type your first letter and stops when you find the student. Your time shows on the result, the share text and the share picture, and Stats keeps your fastest and average find. Guesses still come first.

items.title: Students
items.text: Switch to Students under the header to guess a Blue Archive student. Each guess shows how its school, role, birthday and more compare with the answer's, with arrows for higher or lower. Daily and Endless, each with its own stats and streak.

items.title: Gameplay and Lore
items.text: Gameplay compares kits: school, role, damage and defense type, weapon, EX cost and release, and every costume is its own answer. Lore compares profiles: height, birthday, school year, club, favourite gift and more. Share a picture of your round, or a recap from Stats.

items.title: Sensei card
items.text: Open Sensei card from the ☰ menu for your record across every mode on a Schale licence, with your favourite student's portrait. Share it or download it.

items.title: Birthdays
items.text: On a student's birthday, a note at the top of the page wishes them a happy one.

items.title: Music while you guess
items.text: In Students, the Jukebox plays on after you close it, with a small player in the corner. It shows each song's OST album cover, and songs you've played start at once next time. The OST badges have moved into the ☰ menu.

name: New ways to play the OST

items.title: 4-Choice
items.text: In Endless, switch to 4-Choice: hear a short clip, 1 to 7 seconds as you like, then pick the song from four that sound alike. It has its own stats and streak.

items.title: Time Attack
items.text: Name as many songs as you can in three minutes. Pick the clip length, a random start, and typed or four-choice answers. A miss costs two seconds. Beat your best in Stats, and share a recap.

items.title: Jukebox
items.text: Open the Jukebox from the ☰ menu to play any song in full. Search it or pick OST albums; the songs you've guessed stand out. The repeat button plays on to the next song, or loops the one you love.

items.title: Your name on pictures
items.text: Add a player name in Settings and your shared pictures say Sensei and your name. It stays on your device.

items.title: Share a picture
items.text: Share picture on the result screen makes a picture of your round for X, and Share recap in Stats sums up your record. Daily pictures never show the song.

items.title: Take your progress with you
items.text: Export your progress in every mode to a file in Settings, then import it on another device or browser to carry on there.

items.title: Your record with each song
items.text: The result screen now shows how often you've heard the song, how many times you guessed it and your best number of tries.

items.title: Daily calendar
items.text: Daily stats now have a calendar of every puzzle, coloured by how it went. No song names, so it's safe to show off.

items.title: Play without the mouse
items.text: Just start typing to search. Space plays the clip, Enter guesses and moves on, and Shift+Enter skips.

items.title: Your privacy
items.text: No accounts, cookies, ads or analytics. Your progress stays in this browser. More in About this game.

items.title: Streak places
items.text: Win in a row and the background travels across Kivotos, somewhere new every 10. Daily and Endless each keep their own journey.

items.title: OST badges
items.text: Guess every song on one of the eight soundtrack albums to earn its badge. OST badges in the ☰ menu show how close you are.

items.title: Characters
items.text: Arona and Plana, or Mari, keep you company on wide screens and react to your guesses. Pick one in Settings.

items.title: Blue Archive cursor
items.text: The game's own cursor, with a flash on every click. You can turn it off in Settings.
